# Headsup B2B

> Headsup B2B is India's integrated B2B platform for sourcing, fulfilment, and financing of construction and industrial raw materials — including solar panels, steel, aggregates, sand, tiles, cement, and electricals — serving contractors, EPCs, developers, and industrial buyers across India.

Headsup B2B combines a digital marketplace with credit facilities and end-to-end fulfilment. Buyers can request quotes, upload existing quotes for better pricing, and access collateral-free short-term credit for up to 61 days.

## Core

- [Home](https://www.headsupb2b.com/): Overview of Headsup B2B services — sourcing, fulfilment, and financing for construction materials.
- [About Us](https://www.headsupb2b.com/about): Company background, mission, and leadership.
- [Contact](https://www.headsupb2b.com/contact): Sales enquiry, phone numbers, and office addresses.
- [Careers](https://www.headsupb2b.com/careers): Current openings and how to apply.

## Products & Categories

- [Metal Solutions](https://www.headsupb2b.com/metal-solutions): Solar panels, steel, and metal supply.
- [Electricals](https://www.headsupb2b.com/electricals): Cables, transformers, and electrical accessories.
- [Services](https://www.headsupb2b.com/services): Integrated infrastructure services offering.
